title: Admin QuickPatch plugin: typed remediation snippets & telemetry gating
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a lightweight Admin QuickPatch plugin that lets support engineers launch typed, idempotent remediation snippets (QuickPatches) from the Console and ops CLI. QuickPatches are small, reviewable task modules with typed inputs, dry-run output, and telemetry gating so automatic application requires explicit approval and metric thresholds. This work packages authoring, validation, runtime execution, and telemetry hooks into a single plugin that integrates with runbooks-as-tasks and existing webhook-driven remediations.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI exposes QuickPatch catalog and typed input form with validation and example presets.
CLI command `redwood admin quickpatch run` supports --dry-run and prints structured diff-like output.
QuickPatch artifacts are signed by author and stored in internal catalog with versioning and size limits.
Telemetry gating implemented: auto-apply disabled by default; can configure metric threshold and approval policy; events emitted to 'ops.telemetry.quickpatch' stream.
E2E test demonstrating dry-run -> approval -> apply flow with rollback on failure.
Performance: execution latency for a common QuickPatch must remain < 700ms for control-plane orchestration (excluding remediate action).

dependencies_notes: Depends on runbook scheduler hooks in ENG-314159 for deferred execution and on the admin proxy work in ENG-271444 for permissioned execution.
implementation_notes: Use JSON Schema draft-07 for input typing; store QuickPatch manifest + binary blob in internal artifact store with content-addressed IDs.
Signed manifests via KMS; include signer ID in event payloads for auditability.
Telemetry gating implemented as a small state machine in Console: states = drafted -> dry-run -> awaiting-approval -> canary -> applied -> reverted.
CLI surface must be idempotent: pass --request-id to ensure exactly-once semantics via the control plane.
risks: If gating thresholds are misconfigured, teams may inadvertently block emergency fixes. Mitigation: add explicit 'unsafe-apply' override for on-call with extra audit logging.
Artifact signing and KMS integration increases operational blast radius; ensure KMS access is least-privilege and has key rotation/backup plan.
